title: Small Space TV Stand
text:
Small Space TV Stand. Some of the holes were not carved deep enough to fit the nails that were supposed to go into them. Because of this, we couldn’t install the doors. I asked for a new bottom piece to be sent out, but it’s seeming like they’re asking me to send the whole thing back. Not worth disassembling the entire thing when all I need is one new bottom piece.

Either way, we decided to keep it up without the doors although it would be nice to have them. It’s a great size for an apartment or small space since it isn’t very big.
